title: Side setback, walls above 7.1 m high (R30-R40)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: R5 and above, Wall height above 7.1m: 2.0m.

replaces.note: Part C Table 3.4a applied at R30-R40; 7.1 m+ 3 m -> 2 m (register ch3-057)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to Chapter 3 as a separate record: the Chapter 2 R2-R40 rule allows the pedestrian access way reduction at R30-R40, Chapter 3 C3.4.1(ii) (p33) stops it at R25, so R30-R40 is tested without it. Applies only where the building has walls 7.1 m high and above (condition on building.has_walls_over_7_1m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height. Rounding gap between bands unresolved.

verified.note: Table 3.4a (p33) prints the bands as 'Wall height up to 3.5m', 'Wall height 3.6m to 7m' and 'Wall height above 7.1m', leaving 3.5-3.6 m and 7.0-7.1 m undefined; Table 3A (p7) prints the top band as '7.1m and above'. The encoded band conditions (> 3.5, > 7.0) are an inference. C3.4.1(ii) stops at R25 (p33), so R30-R40 has no pedestrian access way reduction.
